question: Which measured baryonic or profile invariant predicts whether an object prefers an inward or outward radial remap?

symmetric_probe.reason: smallest available nearly symmetric perturbation around the exact parent

statistics.univariate: Spearman rank correlation against every preregistered finite object property
statistics.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery q values within each domain
statistics.raw_cluster_role: six-system descriptive sign check only; no p-value claim from n=6
statistics.promotion_rule: No invariant is promoted unless its FDR q<0.10 in both the galaxy and derived-cluster domains with the same physical direction

claim_limits: The object properties and responses come from spent exploratory data.
Univariate correlations do not establish a causal field invariant.
Galaxy nuisance parameters were previously fitted and CLASH acceleration targets are conventionally reconstructed.
Six raw clusters are too few for a stable multivariable or significance claim.
A correlation may reflect the parent model residual rather than new gravity.
